incumbent_comparison: Compared with v002, v003 materially improves the timber color and directional grain, and the integrated room captures retain the full asset at gameplay distance. The wide top retains board seams and workholding holes, but the vise assembly, drawer joinery and end-grain construction are much simpler than the approved target; the frame still resolves into repeated straight-sided members. No stable production incumbent exists, so v003 remains a best-current review candidate rather than a replacement.
next_action_hypothesis: Backlog this asset after its three approved-target attempts. Resume only with a production mesh workflow that authors shaped casework, turned or curved members, credible fitted joints and target-specific proportions; avoid another material-only loop.
